# Trained SVM Model Artifacts

This directory stores the trained OpenCV SVM model and HOG configuration generated by `EyeSvmTrainer`.

## Generated Files
- `eye_svm.yml` — The trained OpenCV Support Vector Machine model with RBF kernel and optimized hyperparameters.
- `hog_config.properties` — HOG feature extraction parameters (window size, cell size, block stride, bins, feature length) required for matching real-time webcam inference.

## How to Run Training (Pure Java)

### Fast / CIA Demonstration Training (e.g. 1,000 samples per class):
```bash
mvn exec:java -Dexec.mainClass="com.driveguard.ml.EyeSvmTrainer" -DdatasetPath="C:\Users\Merin Joys\Merin\merin\Datasetsdownloads\data" -DmaxSamples=1000 -Dexec.classpathScope=compile
```

### Full Dataset Training (All samples):
```bash
mvn exec:java -Dexec.mainClass="com.driveguard.ml.EyeSvmTrainer" -DdatasetPath="C:\Users\Merin Joys\Merin\merin\Datasetsdownloads\data" -Dexec.classpathScope=compile
```

Training automatically performs 5-fold cross-validation on the training split, outputs the best `C` and `gamma` parameters, saves the model artifacts here, and evaluates accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score, and confusion matrix on the held-out validation and test sets.
